name: New York State Department of Financial Services Cybersecurity Requirements for Financial Services Companies (23 NYCRR Part 500)
description: 23 NYCRR Part 500 is the NYDFS cybersecurity regulation binding on DFS-regulated financial services 'Covered Entities'; the Second Amendment (effective Nov 1, 2023, phasing in through Nov 1, 2025) added governance, asset-management, 72-hour incident and 24-hour ransomware notice, annual compliance certification, and Class A enhanced controls.
